insights: **Weekly Highlights —** Be-You-Tiful Athletics nearly doubled Total Sales to $360, up 91.6% WoW from $188, on 13 units. The BE SECURE Hot Yoga Towel in Dark Gray led with $218 (+98.3%), doubling units to 6 as conversion rose to 7.9%, and the BE YOU Sling & Stretch Strap added $70 (+66.7%) at a 9.3% conversion rate. Organic sales reached $152, and Wednesday, Nov 11 was the peak day at $146.

**Metrics to Watch —** Sales were concentrated in the first half of the week: Thursday, Nov 12 and Saturday, Nov 14 both recorded $0, and the BE YOU Yoga Mat in Black drew 44 sessions without a sale. PPC revenue held flat at $208 while ad spend rose to $463 from $417, so the added spend has not yet produced more ad-attributed sales. On the positive side, total sales grew 91.6% and TACoS improved to 128.6% from 221.90%. We are concentrating ad budget on the towel and strap, which are converting, to keep sales coming in every day of the week.

**Ad Spend Efficiency —** TACoS improved sharply to 128.6% from 221.90% as total sales grew much faster than ad spend. ROAS eased to 0.45x (prior 0.50x), with $463 of spend returning $208 in PPC revenue at a 223.0% ACOS, a 0.20% ad CTR and 2.83% ad conversion. Ad efficiency is the top priority: we are cutting spend on non-converting targets and concentrating budget on the SKUs that are already selling.

**Actions This Week —** (1) Review ad spend on the BE YOU Yoga Mat in Black, which drew 44 sessions without a sale, and move budget to the Dark Gray Hot Yoga Towel (7.9% conversion) and the Sling & Stretch Strap (9.3% conversion). (2) Run a search-term audit and add negatives on non-converting terms, targeting ROAS back above 0.50x and ACOS down from 223.0%. (3) Test new Sponsored Product and Sponsored Brand ad creative to lift ad CTR above 0.20% heading into the holiday season.
